sloka: जाम्बवन्तं हरिश्रेष्ठं मैन्दं द्विविदमेव च।एतदस्त्रबलं दिव्यं मम वा त्र्यम्बकस्य वा ।। ६.९४.३८ ।।
transliteration: jāmbavantaṁ hariśreṣṭhaṁ maindaṁ dvividameva ca।etadastrabalaṁ divyaṁ mama vā tryambakasya vā ।। 6.94.38 ।।

translations.english: Then righteous Sri Rama said to nearby Sugriva, Vibheeshana, Hanuman, Jambavan and leaders of Vanaras like Mainda, Dwivida, that the power of these arrows are in him and Lord Siva only.
